svg.aria-label: Two grids of 121 dots, one for each patient in the test group who relapsed within five years. Left, the model's high-risk list: 81 of 121 relapses caught, 186 patients selected, 43.5 percent of them relapsed. Right, after the filter: 41 of 121 caught, 98 patients selected, 41.8 percent of them relapsed. The filter dropped 40 relapses the model had caught.
svg.title: The result I didn't want
